svg.aria-label: Section through a dome wall showing the buried skirt, the tunnelers' dig depths, ground sensors, the airlock and the tunnel crossing

g.text: A vertical cutaway of a dome wall: how the footing stops a tunnel, and where a tunnel is allowed through.
A CREW THAT HAS LEARNED THE PLACE: 18-26 ft
water table, 28 ft (drawn for the picture; a ditch or creek raises it and floods nearby tunnels)
beats a plain crew (14 + 3 = 17 ft), not a learned one
beats a learned crew too (26 + 3 = 29 ft)
keyed into rock; stops every crew
the dig meets the skirt (a dead end)
so they turn along the footing
AIRLOCK CHAMBER, 28 ft long and 18 ft high
two doors, only one open at a time
the only gap in the skirt
tunnel rises to a floor hatch
Depths to scale, 7.6 px a foot (the ruler counts feet below grade). Skirt depth and thickness, the dig bands and the airlock chamber use the game's own numbers (sim/dome).
The ring beam, the soil layers and the shell above grade are schematic: the strata and the water table are drawn for the picture, they are not a game rule. The dome is shown at its largest tier.
The tunnels drawn in red are what raiders dig; the legitimate tunnel in section B-B is the one the family digs, and it crosses only at an airlock.
share of dig attempts the skirt turns back
In between, the odds slide with how much the raiders have learned the
place. A half-learned crew beats a Geodesic skirt 38% of the time.
A crew digs under the wall, at its usual depth, and
reaches the skirt about 40% of the way through the dig.
It is concrete to a depth set by the tier. If the skirt
runs 3 ft below the crew's dig, the dig is turned back.
Turned crews do not give up: they work along the footing
toward the nearest airlock. The only way in is the door.
Buried ground sensors (a set covers about 390 ft of wall,
powered), dogs, a watcher or a tower can hear the dig
The airlock is two doors and a room between them. Tunnels
cross only here, through a sleeve, to a floor hatch.
Plant pipes and cables run buried inside the same footing
and cross it only in sealed sleeves at the plant yard.
Sally port hold: 3-22 s at the inner door by tier.
Sensors 35% a day (powered, full cover); dog 10% each, 2 max;
listening watcher up to 30%; tower 6%. Source: sim/dome, sim/tunnelers.
